document.name: CUA HUD Dynamic Island Functional Profile
document.purpose: Designer-facing functional brief for redesigning the literal visual form of the HUD while preserving the existing IslandScene architecture, data contract, event model, and interaction behavior.

what_can_change_in_redesign: visual shape of the island shell
proportions and silhouette as long as required content remains legible
placement treatment of regions within the same semantic roles
surface material, border, shadow, background style, and motion language
activity indicator style, if it still represents active/inactive and speed
expanded panel composition, if every required region remains represented

window_behavior.dragging: Dragging anywhere on the island shell moves the HUD; release snaps to screen edges when near margins.
window_behavior.bounds_memory: Current island bounds are remembered for click/toggle detection.
window_behavior.single_instance: Only one HUD instance should be active per profile.

required_items.function: Reserved slot for animated voice/status orb.
Shows active source/title such as Voice control, Automation, Reply, or a compact transcript/response title.
Primary live status, step label, transcript, or reply text. Long text scrolls horizontally.
Shows active transport/tool class: Mic, STT, Socket, HTTP, Router, Screen, Safari, Terminal, Finder, or custom tool.
Shows active target surface: Microphone, STT, Model, macOS, Screen, Safari, Terminal, Finder, Result, or custom target.
Animated activity indicator with active/inactive state and phase-dependent speed.

expanded.role: Inspectable detail view opened by user/programmatic toggle or custom expanded scene.

required_regions.header_left: Orb plus input/title, equivalent to compact left.
required_regions.header_center: Primary status marquee, equivalent to compact center.
required_regions.header_right: Transport, target, and activity indicator, equivalent to compact right.
required_regions.task: Task row containing current prompt/task. May also include step counter.
required_regions.response: Large response/detail row for model reply or current result.
required_regions.details_left: Current action panel with action, phase, and live/idle state.
required_regions.details_right: Two tool rows summarizing transcript/action, tool, app/target, and age.
required_regions.footer: Elapsed time, model label, and transport label.

minimized.role: Small restore capsule when the user presses the yellow stoplight/minimize control.
minimized.interaction: Click restores to compact, non-expanded state.

hud_phases.label: Ready
hud_phases.meaning: No active voice or automation work.

hud_phases.label: Armed
hud_phases.meaning: Keyboard shortcut started a fresh voice turn.

hud_phases.label: Recording Stopped
hud_phases.meaning: Recording has ended and audio is moving into processing.

hud_phases.label: Accepted
hud_phases.meaning: The voice input has been accepted for processing.

hud_phases.label: Planning
hud_phases.meaning: Planner/model or programmed agent step is choosing the next action.

hud_phases.label: Dispatching
hud_phases.meaning: A concrete macOS/browser/clipboard/shell/action command is being executed.

hud_phases.label: Reply
hud_phases.meaning: Final response is visible after voice or automation completion.
hud_phases.display_duration: Minimum 8 seconds; longer if the reply marquee needs time to scroll.

hud_phases.label: Needs attention
hud_phases.meaning: A stopped/error state that should be visibly distinct and actionable.
hud_phases.display_duration: Uses same minimum/scroll-aware duration as Reply.

automation_events: AgentStep(label, source, task, tool, step_index, step_total, ttl_ms)

content_rules.title_precedence: response text compacted to 34 chars, then transcript compacted to 34 chars, otherwise input_label
content_rules.prompt_precedence: transcript if present, otherwise current step label
content_rules.result_precedence: response if present, otherwise transcript, otherwise current step label
compact_center_precedence: reply result when reply flash is visible
Step index/total plus label when step counter exists
content_rules.transcript_visibility: Transcript is kept for 1500ms after Transcript(text), then expires unless replaced.

drag.gesture: left mouse drag anywhere on island shell
drag.result: window follows cursor and snaps on release

double_click_toggle.gesture: double left-click/tap that starts inside island bounds

programmatic_toggle.result: Set or toggle expanded state through ui.island

shell.compact_to_expanded: Width, height, and radius interpolate independently from reply flash.
shell.expansion_easing: ease-out cubic applied to expansion progress.
shell.response_flash_threshold: Reply styling is active when response opacity is at least 0.35.

activity_indicator.active_behavior: A leading dot advances by speed steps per second with trailing alpha/lightness falloff.

orb.motion: Layered blob and ribbon paths driven by elapsed time and phase energy.

ambient.behavior: Declarative light presets render inside the clipped island mask and never resize content, intercept clicks, or execute arbitrary code.

actors.interactive: false only; interactive actors are rejected today

must_show: status formatted as Step n/total plus label

ids.allowed_chars: ASCII letters, numbers, dot, dash, underscore

handoff_notes_for_designer: Treat the dynamic island as a stateful HUD shell, not a static notification.
Every mockup should preserve the compact header information density: identity/source, primary status, transport, target, and activity.
Expanded is not a marketing card; it is an inspection surface for task, response, action, phase, state, tool history, elapsed time, model, and transport.
The redesign should include motion specs for compact-to-expanded, reply flash, long-text marquee, activity indicator, orb phase changes, hover chrome, drag feedback, and minimized restore.
Scene designs should be compatible with programmatic replacement of background/theme/actors through the existing IslandScene API.
